title: Fruits Takeover
blurb: A top-down survival shooter in 30 levels. The orchard took the world and you are the last Juicer: contact leaves rot on you, so standing still is what kills you.

title: Sonic 4: Shattered Horizon
blurb: A 2D platformer in 154 levels. Run, fly, glide or hammer through 17 zones as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles or Amy, collect the 7 Chaos Emeralds, then go Super and take apart Eggman's giant robot.
